problem: E15 found that E14's goal_ref-scoped track record can never break a tie between candidates sharing the same goal_ref, but did not yet test whether other real, already-existing Experience relationships (capability/gap/result) could.

decision.decision_summary: Explored 3 real relational axes (capability-scoped, gap-scoped, result/experience_kind-scoped) against the actual real tied pair. 2 axes tie identically to the goal axis (no new information). The gap axis is asymmetric (1 side inapplicable) -- real, new information, but not a clean resolution, so NOT adopted. E14's mechanism is left completely unchanged.

action.action_summary: Implemented computeScopedTrackRecord() (1 real, minimal generalization of computeGoalTrackRecord(), exploration-only, not wired into any applied decision path) and evaluated it along 3 real axes.

result.note: Verifies whether E14's structural limitation can be resolved with real data; does not change this Goal's own real status. No code executed beyond the 1 exploratory function; no production tie-break logic modified.

cause.root_cause_summary: A goal-scoped track record is, by construction, blind to any distinction between 2 candidates that share the same goal -- this phase tested whether other real relational data could see what the goal axis cannot.

lesson: Correctly declining to force a resolution from an asymmetric or degenerate signal -- rather than defaulting a missing value to 0 just because a number was needed -- is itself the successful outcome this phase was designed to produce; a real, honestly-reported "no clean answer, but here is what we learned" is more valuable than a confident but unjustified tie-break.
